events.name: Happy Accident (18 and Over)
Andrew Hoyt and The Three Day Weekend
events.info: Andrew Hoyt is a full-time touring singer/songwriter blending folk, pop, and acoustic vibes into a sound that is s both warm and unique. He has performed at major venues like Wells Fargo Arena and shared the stage with artists such as AJR, David Archuleta and Eric Hutchinson. His latest EP, Kind of Paradise, produced by Nashvilles Lucas Morton and mixed by Micah Tawlks, marks a new chapter in his artistry. The project features songs co-written with acclaimed artists Matt Wertz and Andy Davis, weaving heartfelt lyrics with melodies that feel like sunshine and nostalgia. Your ticket includes our house greens salad with choice of dressing, basket of dinner rolls with butter, and a selection of entrée options, along with coffee and water. All other drinks such as alcohol, soda, tea, starters, entrée upgrades and desserts are available for purchase during your Ingersoll dining experience. Dining begins TWO HOURS before showtime.

512: The Selena Experience
events.info: 512: The Selena Experience is a mind-blowing experience and the closest one you can get to live a Selena concert. Simply, the best Selena tribute production out there! These musicians came together and orchestrated an extraordinary show that will take you back to 1995 within seconds of their first song. 512 will bring to you the finest Selena tribute that you can possibly imagine. Performing all of Selena?s hits including Como La Flor, Amor Prohibido, Si Una Vez, Bidi Bidi Bom Bom and more... Now, get ready to sing, dance, and relive Selena! Your ticket includes our house greens salad with choice of dressing, basket of dinner rolls with butter, and a selection of entrée options, along with coffee, tea, and water. All other drinks such as alcohol, soda, starters, entrée upgrades and desserts are available for purchase during your Ingersoll dining experience. Dining begins two hours before showtime.
events.pleaseNote: **Dinner: Every ticket to The Ingersoll includes a delicious dining experience. Enjoy your meal in the theater before the show, making your night truly unforgettable. **Timing of Dinner: Dinner seating begins two hours before show time. *For a 1:00 pm matinee performance, please arrive between 11:00am and 11:30 am. *For a 7:30 pm evening performance, please arrive between 5:30 and 6pm. **Club Seating: Tables 38-49 are Club Level seats upstairs and can be accessed using the stairs or the lift. Tables 42 through 49 are high-top tables. The Club Level has a private bar and private restrooms. **Seating Information: Our venue has cabaret seating, which means that you and your party may be sharing a table with other guests. When purchasing your tickets, please purchase seats across from each other (i.e. seats 1 and 2, 3 and 4, or 5 and 6). **Children: While family friendly shows are available, infants are not permitted in the theater. Children ages 5 and older are welcome.
